scope: All narrative positions, all listed terms, independent of gold labels; case-insensitive word boundaries.
limitations: Conservative automated lexicon, not expert-validated exhaustive diagnosis annotation. Synonyms and misspellings may remain. Diagnostic nouns can themselves carry legitimate context. Mask tokens introduce distribution shift. No mechanistic proof of reasoning.
selection: Frozen before masked model inference; no model selection or tuning.
verification: Final distributed code reproduces all masked narratives exactly. Reporting and checkpoint persistence were added after preparation; masking and inference batch composition are unchanged.
